channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula reclama com assessor durante o G7: “Fico puto”
item.description: President Lula expressed irritation upon arriving late to the G7 meeting in France on June 17, 2026, complaining to his aide that he was 'pissed off' about the situation. He disputed an aide's claim that other leaders were already present, stating he found only one person in the room. The exchange was captured on an open microphone before he was informed the press was filming.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula fala a jornalistas após participar da Cúpula do G7
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will speak to journalists after attending the G7 Summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, marking his 10th appearance as a guest. Although Brazil is not a member of the G7 and does not participate in final negotiations, its delegation may endorse texts of interest after approval by member states. Lula also met with von der Leyen and Costa, while Trump passed by him without greeting.

item.title: Governo calcula impacto de R$ 22,4 bilhões com renegociação de dívidas agrícolas em 2027; meta de contas no azul ficaria mais difícil
item.description: The federal government estimates that the agricultural debt renegotiation, approved by the Senate, will have a fiscal impact of R$ 22.4 billion in 2027, making it harder to achieve the primary surplus target of 0.5% of GDP (R$ 73.2 billion) set in the Budget Guidelines Law. The measure, which will benefit producers affected by extreme weather and geopolitical conflicts, involves a new credit line of R$ 200 billion and could raise the total cost to the Union to R$ 139.8 billion over 13 years. Without full exclusion of court-ordered payments (precatory debts), the government projects only R$ 8 billion in primary surplus for 2027, far below the desired target.

item.title: O que disse Trump ao encontrar Lula no G7
item.description: Lula and Trump had a brief encounter at the G7 in France after missing each other in the official photo. In leaked audio, Lula said he 'cannot tolerate the behavior' of the U.S. government, criticizing protectionism and the unilateral designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorists. The meeting aimed to address threats of new 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, but no formal bilateral talk took place.

item.title: Economistas avaliam discurso de Lula e recado a Trump
item.description: Lula used his G7 speech to call for greater multilateralism and criticize U.S. protectionism, particularly the tariffs announced by the White House, while Trump passed by him without greeting during the 'family photo'. Economists, such as Sérgio Vale of MB Associados, noted that Lula's speech inappropriately mixed topics like neoliberalism and fiscal responsibility, arguing that fiscal discipline is necessary to sustain social policies, not opposed to them. The incident was interpreted as a sign of growing tension in Brazil-U.S. trade relations.

item.title: Tarcísio vê condenação de Eduardo "injusta" e sem efeito sobre chapa
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas called Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF conviction for obstructing justice in the coup plot unjust, stating it will not affect his group's electoral ticket. Eduardo was sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime and 8 years of ineligibility, with appeal possible. Experts note the penalty may require candidate substitution up to 20 days before the first round, as Electoral Justice treats the ticket as a unit.

item.title: “Nunca fui esquerdista”, diz Lula a presidente do FMI
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva told IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva in an informal conversation that he 'was never a leftist', countering expectations that his first administration would pursue left-wing policies. Lula emphasized that, despite predictions, his government followed a moderate path focused on economic stability. The remark came as Georgieva noted the positive surprise of Lula’s first term in office.

item.title: Visita ao Poder: Daniella Marques
item.description: Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal and administrator, visited the Poder360 headquarters in Brasília on Wednesday, June 17, 2026. She is part of the economic core of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign, the PL’s pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic.

item.title: Flávio caiu nas pesquisas e finge defender Bolsa Família, diz PT
item.description: The PT released a video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, claiming he is declining in polls and falsely defending the Bolsa Família program, despite his father Jair Bolsonaro's history of opposing it. Flávio had previously supported the program as an acquired right and proposed extending its benefits after beneficiaries enter formal employment.

item.title: Tarcísio ‘joga parado’ ao ver Eduardo condenado pelo STF e deve conter apoio a André do Prado
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will adopt a 'standing still' stance in André do Prado's Senate campaign, avoiding explicit support due to Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF conviction for attempting to interfere in the coup plot case, which could provoke adversarial attacks linking the ticket to international sanctions and harm his relationship with the Supreme Court. Eduardo Bolsonaro, sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime, remains as substitute on Do Prado's ticket and insists on staying in the race despite being abroad.

item.title: Leia a íntegra do discurso de Lula no G7 sobre regulamentação das redes
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva spoke at the G7 on artificial intelligence and protection of minors online, criticizing the concentration of power by big techs and noting their valuations rival major economies while 2.6 billion people remain offline. He praised the Digital ECA as one of the world’s most advanced laws for protecting children and adolescents in digital spaces.

item.title: TSE e partidos políticos firmam acordo pela integridade das Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE and 26 of the 30 registered political parties in Brazil signed a commitment term to ensure the integrity of the 2026 Elections, focusing on combating disinformation, responsible AI use, citizen participation, and electoral trust. The agreement does not create new legal obligations or sanctions but strengthens institutional cooperation between the Electoral Justice and the parties, as emphasized by TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: No G7, Lula defende regulamentação e critica valor de big techs
item.description: At the G7, President Lula advocated for social media regulation and criticized the disproportionate valuation of big techs, noting that 2.6 billion people remain offline while companies like Elon Musk’s SpaceX reach a $2.65 trillion market cap. He also praised Brazil’s Digital ECA as a global benchmark for protecting minors online and warned that AI could deepen inequalities without deliberate action.

item.title: Em áudio ‘vazado’, Lula diz que ‘não suporta comportamento’ de governo Trump
item.description: In a leaked audio from the G7 summit in France, Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the behavior of the U.S. government, saying he 'cannot stand' its approach, amid trade tensions and Washington’s designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorists. He also stated that Brazil 'does not like conflict' and that the world follows the 'middle way', reaffirming his background as a union leader rather than a leftist ideologue. Lula had sought a bilateral meeting with Trump to address differences, but the two did not greet each other during the official 'family photo'.

item.title: Mídia internacional noticia condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro pelo STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced by Brazil's Supreme Court to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime for coercion in the judicial process, after pressuring the U.S. government to threaten Brazilian authorities and obstruct his father's trial. The ruling renders him ineligible for public office for 8 years and confirms the December 2025 cancellation of his congressional mandate. International outlets including The Guardian, Washington Post, Reuters, and Al Jazeera highlighted the conviction as another legal setback for the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Lula deve visitar MG ainda sem candidato a governador, e PT local cobra definição do presidente
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is scheduled to visit Minas Gerais this week without yet having a defined gubernatorial candidate for the party in the state. The Minas Gerais PT directory expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of definition and has begun pressuring the president to make a decision on the state's major ticket. The visit occurs amid political maneuvering for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Big techs deverão comunicar retirada de conteúdo sem ordem judicial, aprova CDH
item.description: The Senate Human Rights Committee approved Bill 3.283/2025, requiring internet platforms to notify the removal of content without a judicial order within 24 hours to the CNJ, CNMP, OAB, and National Congress, aiming to increase transparency and prevent censorship following an STF ruling that limited provider liability. The mandate does not apply to automatic removals targeting spam, malware, fraud, or copyright violations.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro foi injusta
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas condemned the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion in the course of legal proceedings as unjust. He defended the federal deputy’s acquittal, arguing the judicial decision was excessive. The statement was made in an interview released on June 17, 2026.

item.title: Brasil insiste em pressão contra tarifas após EUA não realizar reunião bilateral
item.description: The Brazilian government continues to pressure the U.S. to reverse the 37.5% tariffs on Brazilian products announced by Donald Trump, despite the lack of a bilateral meeting between Lula and Trump at the G7 summit in France. Lula is awaiting a phone call from Trump to explain Brazil’s position, which views the tariffs as a political tool rather than a commercial measure, aimed at strengthening Trump’s negotiating leverage.

item.title: Antes de julgamento no STF, Lula reforça defesa da regulação das big techs no G7
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated at the G7 for regulating digital platforms to protect women, children, and adolescents from digital crimes, stating that regulating the digital environment is central to safeguarding fundamental rights. His remarks came on the same day the Supreme Federal Court (STF) resumed judgment on appeals by tech companies like Facebook and Google challenging the court’s expansion of platform liability for user-generated criminal content, even without a judicial order. The STF had previously set a 60-day deadline for big techs to implement 'duty of care' measures, including specific channels for content removal requests.

item.title: Sérgio Moro responde comparação de Gilmar Mendes do caso Master com Operação Lava Jato: ‘Ladainha’
item.description: Senator Sérgio Moro criticized Minister Gilmar Mendes' comparison between Operation Compliance Zero and Operation Lava Jato, calling it a 'ladainha'. He welcomed the STF's decision to maintain the preventive detention of Henrique and Felipe Vorcaro in the Banco Master case, calling it a victory for law and justice. Moro also praised the votes of André Mendonça, Luiz Fux, and Nunes Marques in favor of keeping the precautionary measures.

item.title: Caso Eduardo Bolsonaro: qual a fronteira entre a política e o direito?
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler analyzes the STF's ruling that convicted Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion, questioning the legitimacy of lawmakers appealing to foreign institutions against Brazilian judicial decisions. He notes that while similar actions were taken by deputies in defense of Lula, there is now a trend to criminalize such conduct, which he views as dangerous for democracy. Schüler emphasizes that the real issue is not criticizing judicial decisions, but politically attacking institutions, which characterizes a non-republican regime.

item.title: Lula e Trump se cumprimentam no G7, mas reunião é descartada
item.description: Lula and Trump had informal encounters during the G7 summit in France, with no official bilateral meeting taking place. The interactions were brief and casual, including a corridor greeting and a social event hosted by Macron. Trade negotiations between Brazil and the U.S. continue at the ministerial level, without discussion of the recently announced U.S. tariffs.

item.title: Flávio posta vídeo de IA em que bombardeia embarcações do PCC e CV e mira o PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) shared an AI-generated video in which he appears bombing vessels linked to the criminal factions PCC and CV, while targeting a boat marked with the PT’s identification, announcing he will deliver 'bad news' to these groups on the following Thursday. The video features him alongside his father, former president Jair Bolsonaro, both dressed in military attire and holding machine guns. The post aligns with his strategy to position himself as a presidential candidate focused on combating organized crime, following his weakened standing in polls due to the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: ‘Eu sou o chefe’: falas e atitudes de Trump a líderes reunidos no G7 criam climão
item.description: At the G7 summit in France, President Donald Trump declared 'I am the boss' as he took his seat to the right of Emmanuel Macron, drawing laughter from some leaders like German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, while others, including UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer, remained stern. Lula da Silva was seen writing upon arrival and showed no reaction to Trump's comment, nor did they greet each other during the 'family photo'. Trump also complained about the room's heat and reiterated that Russia should reach a deal with Ukraine, stating he wants to end the monthly deaths of 25,000 young people in the war.

item.title: Lula e Trump trocam cumprimentos e falam rapidamente em evento social do G7 na França
item.description: Lula and Trump exchanged brief, informal greetings during social events at the G7 summit in France, with no bilateral discussion or formal meeting. Their interactions occurred after a musical performance and in a hotel corridor, where Trump said 'How are you?' and 'Good job' to Lula, who responded with a head nod. Despite the symbolic exchange, no direct negotiations on tariffs or other issues took place, as such matters remain handled at the ministerial level.

item.title: PEC do fim da 6 X 1 deve ficar para julho, diz presidente da CCJ
item.description: The president of the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), Senator Otto Alencar (PSD-BA), said the processing of the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule should be postponed to the first half of July, due to lower Senate activity during the June festivals and the World Cup. He added that approval before the July legislative recess is possible, depending on talks between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula. Senator Randolfe Rodrigues (PT-AP) advocates shortening the 14-month transition period, arguing that Brazilian workers have waited 150 years for this change.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: André Mendonça dá lição de moral em Gilmar
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program covered Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF trial, a heated exchange between ministers André Mendonça and Gilmar Mendes, and new PF revelations in the Banco Master case. Mendonça was noted for delivering a 'moral lesson' to Gilmar during the discussion.

item.title: Justiça manda governo suspender anúncios sobre fim da 6 X 1
item.description: The TJDFT ordered the Lula government to suspend paid social media ads advocating for the end of the 6x1 work schedule within 48 hours, following a popular action by Deputy Carlos Jordy (PL-RJ). The judge found evidence of potentially irregular use of public funds, with R$881,000 spent between April 15–18, 2026, coinciding with the CCJ vote in the Chamber of Deputies. The government may still communicate the issue via official channels, provided no paid boosting is used.

item.title: Kassio derruba decisão de Moraes e volta a autorizar falas de advogados em referendos no TSE
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques overturned a decision by Alexandre de Moraes at the TSE, re-authorizing oral arguments by lawyers in individual case analyses. The possibility had been revoked in 2022. The move comes amid discussions on transparency and access to defense in electoral matters.

item.title: Forças Armadas são acionadas para a disputa pelo governo de Roraima
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, acting as President, authorized via decree logistical support from the Armed Forces to ensure infrastructure and transportation function properly during Roraima's supplementary gubernatorial election on June 21, 2026. The move follows the removal of Governor Edilson Damião and the eight-year ineligibility of former Governor Antonio Denarium by the TSE. The race features three candidates: Antonia Pedrosa (PT), Arthur Henrique (PL), and Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos).

item.title: Pressão sobre Moraes para levar ao plenário físico julgamento sobre anistia a partidos
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes returned the request for a view in the case assessing the constitutionality of the amendment that establishes rules for electoral financing of Black candidacies and pardons prior non-compliance by political parties, increasing pressure for the matter to be brought before the STF’s physical plenary. The decision opens space for political and legal mobilizations around party amnesty and the amendment’s constitutionality. Full content is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Vice de Flávio Bolsonaro seria saída honrosa para Cleitinho
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo, Minas Gerais senator and current leader in polls for governor, is being considered as Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) running mate to avoid the risks of a majoritarian candidacy he does not wish to pursue due to Minas' financial instability and his own doubts about career productivity. The arrangement is framed as an 'honorable exit' to maintain his political visibility without the high stakes of governing the state, while PL allies see him as a strategic pick to complete the ticket. However, internal opposition exists, fearing that close alignment with Bolsonaro could harm his standing in Lula-leaning regions, particularly in northern Minas.

item.title: “Atividade política legítima”, diz Valdemar sobre Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL party, defended Eduardo Bolsonaro's international engagements as legitimate political activity carried out by elected representatives. The statement came in an official note of solidarity with the former deputy, who was condemned by the First Chamber of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) on Tuesday, the 16th.

item.title: Dino diz que STF respeita jurisdições de outros países, às vezes sem reciprocidade
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino stated that the STF respects the jurisdictions of other countries, even when reciprocity is not observed, citing Italy’s rejection of Carla Zambelli’s extradition due to alleged bias by Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He emphasized that the STF does not act as a judge over other nations’ courts and maintains a deferent, comprehensive attitude toward global legal systems, except in extreme cases. Dino also affirmed that the Court avoids ethnocentric or arrogant postures toward foreign judicial systems.

item.title: Condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por coação é inovação do STF? Saiba o que dizem juristas
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced by the First Chamber of the STF to 4 years and 2 months in prison, semi-open regime, and a fine of R$165,000 for coercion during the judicial process related to the 2022 coup attempt, along with 8 years of ineligibility. Legal experts are divided on whether the ruling represents an innovative, expansive interpretation of coercion by the STF, though they agree that freedom of expression does not shield threats against the judiciary.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Caso Master ainda gera discórdia no Supremo e paira sobre cúpula do Congresso
item.description: The Master case continues to create tensions between the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court and Congress, with clashes between justices Gilmar Mendes and André Mendonça over prison decisions and case secrecy, affecting figures like Ciro Nogueira. Meanwhile, lawmakers such as Davi Alcolumbre and Hugo Motta have been implicated in allegations tied to payments from Daniel Vorcaro, while Flávio Bolsonaro attempts to recover politically by focusing on economic issues and Eduardo Bolsonaro was convicted by the STF for actions in the United States.

item.title: Republicanos faz ofensiva na Justiça Eleitoral contra postagens críticas a Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: The Republicans party, led by São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, has filed eight electoral lawsuits in two months to remove critical social media posts about the governor, alleging illegal boosting of negative content. Four lawsuits target state deputy Antonio Donato (PT), three target the Facebook page 'Contra a Maré', and one targets councilman Chico Nogueira (PT), all for posts criticizing Tarcísio and praising Fernando Haddad, the pre-candidate for state governor. No rulings have been issued yet — only preliminary injunctions have been granted.

item.title: Lei cria órgão para monitorar decisões internacionais sobre direitos humanos
item.description: Law 15.434/2026 was published, creating the Department of Monitoring and Enforcement of International Human Rights Decisions (DDH) linked to the National Justice Council (CNJ) to oversee Brazil’s compliance with international human rights rulings and recommendations. The department will be coordinated by an auxiliary judge appointed by the CNJ president and may establish cooperation agreements and hire specialists. The presidential veto removed a provision requiring public authorities to observe international bodies’ decisions, citing unconstitutional encroachment on federal executive authority in foreign policy.

item.title: Sabe o que é campanha eleitoral? O Glossário explica
item.description: According to the TSE's Electoral Glossary, an electoral campaign is the period in which parties, candidates, or aspirants promote their candidacies after the party convention. It includes electoral propaganda and free electoral airtime, aiming to attract votes. For the 2026 Elections, party conventions will take place from July 20 to August 5, marking the official start of the campaign.

item.title: Lula e Trump se cumprimentam em evento social, mas sem debater tarifas
item.description: Lula and Trump exchanged greetings at a social event during the G7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, on the evening of June 16, 2026, but did not discuss tariffs. Despite the greeting, Trump had previously ignored Lula during the official summit photo, fueling speculation about bilateral tensions. The meeting took place amid rising trade disputes, after the U.S. proposed new tariffs on Brazilian goods, citing unfair trade practices.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: a disputa Lula x Flávio após últimos números e o novo Datafolha
item.description: Recent CNT/MDA and BTG/Nexus polls show Lula expanding his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro, with 49.3% to 36.8% in the CNT/MDA second-round scenario (a 12.5-point gap) and 49% to 43% in the BTG/Nexus poll. The upcoming Datafolha survey, fielded March 17–19 with 2,004 interviews, will test whether this trend holds, also measuring vote intentions, government approval, economic and security perceptions, and potential impact of Donald Trump’s endorsement.

item.title: Lula e Trump se cumprimentam durante evento social do G7
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump exchanged greetings during a social event at the G7 summit in France, following a concert hosted by Emmanuel Macron. Although they were in close proximity during the 'family photo' of the summit, they did not interact at that time. Lula’s aides confirmed the greeting was not captured on photo or video, and no formal bilateral meeting was requested by either side.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro vive em mundo paralelo e se consolida como ‘camisa 10’ da campanha de Lula
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF conviction for coercing ministers unintentionally boosted Lula's campaign by linking his name to U.S. sanctions threats against Brazil, damaging Bolsonaro's image. His absence from the U.S. and Flávio Bolsonaro's meetings with Donald Trump are alienating independent voters, while Bolsonaro allies consider replacing him with Rogério Marinho for the 2026 race amid declining polls and fears of new scandals.

item.title: Uma arquitetura institucional para a soberania digital brasileira
item.description: Brazil, under the Lula government, has advanced its digital sovereignty agenda but still lacks a permanent institutional architecture to sustain it. Reliance on direct presidential action makes the policy fragile and vulnerable to government changes. A centralized body, like the UK’s DSIT, is needed to integrate dispersed competencies across ministries and ensure continuity, decision-making power, and coherence in governing digital infrastructure, data, semiconductors, and AI.

item.title: Em pré-campanha, André do Prado congela pauta da Alesp há três semanas
item.description: André do Prado, president of Alesp and Senate pre-candidate, has suspended the leaders' college meetings for three weeks, halting the state legislative agenda. The only vote expected before the recess is the 2026 LDO, while other bills, such as the teacher career restructuring, are postponed until after the election. His agenda has been dominated by political alignments with Tarcísio de Freitas and pre-campaign events, drawing criticism from legislators for neglecting his legislative duties.

item.title: Dino desautoriza TSE e reafirma decisão que impede candidatura de Arthur Henrique em RR
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino reaffirmed the decision blocking Arthur Henrique’s (PL) candidacy for governor of Roraima, upholding the requirement for public officials to resign three to six months before the June 21 supplementary election. He emphasized that the TSE’s administrative process cannot override the STF’s constitutional authority and that the ruling remains 'full and current,' regardless of the pending vote by Justice Cármen Lúcia. The decision follows the TRE-RR’s prior denial of Arthur Henrique’s candidacy registration.

item.title: Focos de Lula e Flávio, partidos do Centrão tendem a liberar filiados
item.description: Centrão parties are leaning toward releasing members to support presidential candidates based on state preferences, without formalizing national alliances until July-August conventions. Lula sought to attract the bloc to expand his campaign’s reach, including negotiations with MDB for a vice-presidential slot, but the party shows a tendency toward neutrality. Flávio Bolsonaro pursued alliances with PP and União Brasil, but investigations into Banco Master and Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP) have caused a rift, undermining the talks.

item.title: Sem trégua institucional
item.description: The unanimous condemnation of Eduardo Bolsonaro by the First Chamber of the STF and the defensive speech by Davi Alcolumbre, president of Congress, amid accusations of receiving money from Daniel Vorcaro, reveal the depth of Brazil's institutional crisis. Though isolated events, both expose a pattern of confrontation between branches of government and a lack of truce in the political arena, indicating the country remains in a prolonged state of institutional tension.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro condenado por coação de Justiça - O Assunto #1741
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) unanimously convicted former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro of obstruction of justice, sentencing him to 4 years and 2 months in prison and 12 years of political ineligibility for attempting to pressure the U.S. government into imposing sanctions on Brazil to benefit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, in the 2022 coup plot trial. The ruling, led by Minister Alexandre de Moraes and supported by Cristiano Zanin, Cármen Lúcia and Flávio Dino, underscores a coordinated effort to undermine Brazil’s judiciary through foreign influence.
